By way of present petition, the petitioners seek directions to the trial court for early disposal of the
case arising out of Fir No.337/2019, registered under Sections 376/354 Ipc at P.S. Prashant Vihar,
Rohini, Delhi

. 
2.  During the course of submissions, learned counsels for the parties submit that the matter is at the stage of prosecution evidence and that the prosecutrix has already been examined.
It is further informed that till date only 2 out of 16 witnesses have been examined.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in the present case, the prosecutrix has levelled allegations against her in-laws.

4. Considering that the FIR pertains to the year 2019 and that 5 years have passed and only formal witnesses remain to be examined, the trial court shall make an endeavour to expedite the trial and conclude the same within
